correctness.rationale: The identity is universal in the full enhanced power graph, so diameter is at most 2. For order at least \(4\) its degree is at least 3, excluding paths; order \(3\) gives \(K_3\). The published diameter-two theorem then forces infinite multiset dimension. Orders 1 and 2 are paths and have multiset dimension 1 under the cited convention.
